## 📊 Featured Project

### [QuantTrading](https://github.com/you200109/quanttrading)
Quantitative trading visualization system with real-time market data, K-line charts, 508 technical indicators, backtesting, and AI evolution modules.

- **Backend**: Python 3.12, FastAPI, uvicorn
- **Frontend**: HTML/CSS/JS, Chart.js
- **AI**: crewai, AGI brain, genetic evolution
- **Exchange**: OKX API (spot trading)
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions, CodeQL, Dependabot
- **Cloud Dev**: GitHub Codespaces

#### Key Features
- 508 technical indicators (pandas-ta)
- 11 API endpoints for vc integration
- Unit tests (pytest, backend + vc modules)
- WebSocket real-time data
- Backtesting with risk management
